description: Canadair Starfighter displayed in the formal park on Şehit Enver Tok Caddesi at Bahçelievler Mahallesi in Altınordu, wearing the code 8-869. Construction number 683A-1169. The International F-104 Society records a grey F-16 style scheme. Confirmed present on Esri World Imagery examined September 2026, which resolves a jet-shaped object on the paved centrepiece of the park.
